Build HDXBoxeR input from a long table

Source: R/read_hdx.R
as_hdx_long.Rd

For data from any software: give one row per measurement (peptide, charge, state, time, replicate) and name the columns that hold each quantity. The result can be passed to any function that takes filepath.

Usage

as_hdx_long(
  data,
  state,
  time,
  replicate,
  start,
  end,
  sequence,
  uptake,
  charge = NULL,
  percent = NULL,
  rt = NULL,
  centroid = NULL,
  time_unit = c("s", "min", "h"),
  undeuterated = 0,
  fd = NULL
)

Arguments

data

data frame with one row per measurement.

state, time, replicate, start, end, sequence, uptake

names of the columns holding the protein state, labeling time, replicate (experiment/run name), peptide start and end residue, sequence and deuterium uptake in Da.

charge

optional column with the charge state (default: every peptide charge 1).

percent

optional column with percent deuteration; by default 100 * uptake / (length - 1 - prolines after the first residue), the theoretical maximum HDXExaminer and DynamX use.

rt

optional column with retention time (default 0).

centroid

optional column with the measured centroid m/z (needed only for backHX_calculations()).

time_unit

unit of a numeric time column: "s" (default), "min" or "h". Character times are used as they are.

undeuterated

time value of undeuterated controls (default 0); these rows become "0s".

fd

optional time value marking fully deuterated controls (e.g. "FD" or Inf); these rows become "FD".

Value

data frame of class hdx_data.

See also

read_hdx()

Examples

long <- data.frame(state = rep(c("apo", "holo"), each = 6),
                   t_min = rep(rep(c(1, 10), each = 3), 2),
                   run = rep(paste0("r", 1:3), 4),
                   from = 5, to = 14, seq = "YIAKQRPISF",
                   D = c(1.1, 1.2, 1.15, 2.4, 2.5, 2.45, 0.9, 1.0, 0.95, 2.0, 2.1, 2.05))
d <- as_hdx_long(long, state = "state", time = "t_min", replicate = "run",
                 start = "from", end = "to", sequence = "seq", uptake = "D",
                 time_unit = "min")
output_tp(d)
#> Protein.States used: apo holo
#> Deut.times used: 60.00s 600.00s
#> Number of replicates used: apo=3 holo=3
#> no csv file written
#>   Deut.Time Start End   Sequence Search.RT Charge apo_X..Deut_1 apo_X..Deut_2
#> 1    60.00s     5  14 YIAKQRPISF         0      1           1.1           1.2
#> 2   600.00s     5  14 YIAKQRPISF         0      1           2.4           2.5
#>   apo_X..Deut_3 holo_X..Deut_1 holo_X..Deut_2 holo_X..Deut_3
#> 1          1.15            0.9            1.0           0.95
#> 2          2.45            2.0            2.1           2.05
